question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Operating base: guide $108B rev, 74% GM, $9.2B GAAP opex; assuming typical ~3% beat, ~16.5% tax and 24.25B shares, GAAP EPS before equity gains is ~$2.57 (non-GAAP consensus is $2.47-2.53). GAAP adds mark-to-market equity gains: SpaceX stake (~$21B) rose ~25-30% from ~$115 to $147.49 between Jul 24 and Oct 23 (~+$5-6B), and Intel fell from $92.32 to $86.96 (~-$1.2B). Other holdings are unknown, and Intel's October drop hints semis were weak. No large private markup is expected: the OpenAI round hadn't closed by Oct 22 and Anthropic filed for its IPO after the quarter ended. Net about +$3.5B pretax, or ~+$0.11, for a median of ~$2.68 with upside skew from private revaluations. No human market found (Polymarket/Manifold none; Kalshi only had prior-year items).
